stories.title: Power cut hits part of Lixwm with supply due back around 4pm
stories.summary: Part of Lixwm is without power this afternoon after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 4.16pm. stories.title: Traffic Officers across North Wales now carry defibrillators after charity donation
stories.summary: Save a Life Cymru has donated 16 defibrillators to Traffic Wales, with half going to officers who patrol the main routes through Flintshire.

stories.title: A541 closed at Afonwen near Mold after collision
stories.summary: The A541 at Afonwen, near Mold, has been closed after a road traffic collision. North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team said emergency services were in attendance and a road closure was in place. stories.title: Two arrested in Flintshire overnight over suspected cooking oil theft
stories.summary: Two people were arrested in south Flintshire overnight on suspicion of stealing cooking oil, police have said. Officers were called out 40 times overnight, according to an update from North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team.
